# Ralliant Opens Global Headquarters in Raleigh, North Carolina


RALEIGH, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ralliant Corporation (“Ralliant” or the “Company”) (NYSE: RAL) today officially opened its global headquarters in Raleigh, marking an important milestone in the company’s first year as a standalone public company.
